question: Where are a café positioned within 100 kilometers relative to Franklin Pierce University, Rindge, NH in the southeast direction?
sql: SELECT poi_name, addr_city, addr_state FROM pois AS p WHERE p.amenity = 'cafe' AND ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, ( SELECT geometry::geography FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Franklin Pierce University%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Rindge%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NH%' LIMIT 1 ), 100000) AND degrees(ST_Azimuth( ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Franklin Pierce University%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Rindge%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NH%' LIMIT 1 ), p.geometry )) BETWEEN 112.5 AND 157.5;
